eligibility_tiers.line: 11th and 12th grade students interested in diploma or certificate programs must submit an overall GPA of 2.0 or higher after the completion of the 10th grade or other admission test score requirements.
11th and 12th grade students interested in degree programs must submit an overall GPA of 2.5 or higher after the completion of the 10th grade or other admission test score requirements.
10th grade students interested in diploma or certificate programs must submit an overall GPA of 2.0 or higher after the completion of the 9th grade or other admission test score requirements.
